caption: An excavator drops a load of rubble into a steel skip, and a nearby chain-link fence shivers along its length.

sa.check: An excavator holds a load of rubble above a steel skip.
The rubble drops into the skip.
The shiver runs along the fence's length, not just one post.
The drop comes first and the shiver follows.

pc.expect: The fence is still until the rubble lands and starts shivering at the impact.
pc.fail: The fence shivers before the rubble hits the skip; or the rubble lands and the fence stays dead still; or the fence starts shivering again after settling with no second load.

pc.expect: The shiver is strongest at the impact and fades afterwards.
pc.fail: The shiver grows after the impact; or keeps the same strength to the end; or the fence stops dead bowed out in a bent pose.

pc.expect: The rubble falls downward into the skip and stays there.
pc.fail: Rubble rises out of the skip after landing; or hangs in the air below the bucket; or pieces fall upward; or the bucket opens and the rubble stays in it hanging in place.

pc.expect: The mesh flexes between fixed posts; the skip is rigid steel.
pc.fail: The mesh stretches like elastic and stays stretched; or a post bends and springs back like rubber; or the skip's side ripples like cloth.

pc.expect: One excavator, one skip, a continuous fence; the rubble does not pass through the skip.
pc.fail: Rubble passes through the skip's floor or side; or the skip vanishes; or the fence gains or loses a section; or the excavator's arm passes through the skip.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The excavator's colour, the skip's markings and the fence posts stay the same.
pc.fail: The excavator changes colour; or the skip's markings change; or the fence posts move.
